_why: toggl_project is the project NAME, exactly. It is the only field the Toggl
extension acts on: its resolve-project handler takes { projectName,
selectedWorkspaceId } and nothing else, matches on u.name === n, and among
identically named projects returns the first one it finds.
So a rule gets a name ONLY when that name identifies exactly one project.
Where it does not, leave toggl_project out: the task then tracks with no
project, which is better than tracking against some other client's project.
toggl_project_id is carried for reference and has no effect.
First matching rule wins in file order, so epic rules go above key_prefix
rules. Resolved at sync time, so edit this and re-sync.
